pe_assessment: Current Yahoo metadata quotes trailing P/E 27.12 and forward P/E 18.15, but the deterministic fundamental context cannot establish dated same-share-basis valuation. Do not label the stock cheap or derive a target from these ratios. Yahoo quarterly EPS is TWD147.127873 with no declared share basis; the October 15 official Q3 release reports NT$29.43 per ordinary share and US$4.60 per ADR. These bases must not be mixed or one quarter annualized.
margin_analysis: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, official margins were 66.4% gross, 58.7% operating and 51.1% net. The provider's comparable Q3 2025 margins were approximately 59.5%, 50.6% and 45.7%, supporting year-over-year improvement. Gross and operating margins were below the provider's Q2 2026 values of 67.7% and 60.3%, so improvement is not uniform sequentially.
debt_analysis: The latest Yahoo quarter lacks debt, equity and free cash flow. The official Q3 presentation supplies NT$4,016.98bn cash and marketable securities, NT$818.38bn long-term interest-bearing debt and NT$7,043.23bn equity; long-term debt is not total debt. Official Q3 free cash flow was NT$476.56bn. The balance-sheet and cash-flow evidence is supportive, without proving unrestricted cash availability or eliminating capital-spending risk.
growth_outlook: The deterministic comparable-quarter calculation gives Q3 revenue growth of 50.95% and net-income growth of 68.71% versus Q3 2025, consistent with the October 15 official release's rounded figures. The official Q4 revenue guidance is US$52.3bn to US$54.3bn and management expects around 44% full-year US-dollar revenue growth; these are forecasts, not realized results.
key_risks: The current-provider share basis is missing and quarterly EPS differs from ordinary-share presentation; same-basis valuation remains unavailable.
Provider Q3 debt/equity/cash-flow fields are incomplete; official supplementary evidence must retain its separate source and partial-debt scope.
Capital-intensive capacity expansion and reliance on sustained leading-edge demand expose future cash flow to execution and demand risk; this is an inference, not an observed demand collapse.
key_strengths: Comparable Q3 revenue and profit grew strongly year over year, with higher observed margins.
Official Q3 cash-flow and balance-sheet disclosures support financial capacity for ongoing investment.
Official Q4 guidance supports a continued growth outlook, conditional on management assumptions.
summary: Fundamentals favor a cautiously positive view based on observed comparable-quarter growth, margins and official cash generation. This is a medium-confidence fundamental buy signal, not a conclusion that today's ADR price is cheap or an immediate portfolio order. The September 30 financial period is 27 days old; current-provider observation on October 27 is not an original filing timestamp.
